milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a birch log block drops a birch_log item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory, so any birch_log present confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a wooden sword produces the item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no wooden_sword, so its presence confirms successful crafting. All wood plank types (including birch) produce the same generic 'wooden_sword' item. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks since the crafted item ends up in inventory.
